reason: I'd install it the day I hear about it because I install everything, but my class WhatsApp group already tells me about deadlines and exams, so after a week of alerts I'd mute it and delete it like most apps.
objection: Not another app on my phone. If it's just the same notices from the college Outlook I never open, I don't need a separate app for it, my friends already forward the important stuff.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually had my marks and timetable changes before the WhatsApp group did, so it was the fastest place to find out, I'd keep it.
